title: Care-for-the-session doctrine names the release step

truths: The AGENTS block source tells agents to run bee state session release when ending substantial work, after caps and reservation release
Derived AGENTS.md files match the regenerated block and any pinning test is green

action: In packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md, section 'Care for the session', extend the 'Before ending substantial work' item: after capping cells and releasing reservations, run `bee state session release` so sibling sessions stop counting this one as a live worker (the next user message re-engages it automatically). Then regenerate every derived copy the way the repo does (find the regen: rg 'AGENTS.block' across src and dev verbs — likely `bee dev regen` or part of render manifests; AGENTS.md at repo root imports or embeds the block). Do NOT hand-edit derived files if a regen exists; if the regen chain is not runnable, name the gap and edit the minimal derived copies consistently. Update any test pinning the block text (rg 'Before ending substantial work' in tests).
intent: The verb only helps if agents actually run it; the AGENTS block is where that discipline lives.
